finalText:
I've created the **Settings** canvas at `ui/Settings.tsx`. It has four desktop artboards (1440 × 1024): General, Account, Notifications and Privacy, all in the maude design system. The studio's strict check passes. I screenshotted all four and each one renders and fits its artboard. The captures only came out as small thumbnails, though, so I checked the layout but not the fine detail.

Every page is the same Settings window, set up like `GitPanel`:
- **Top bar:** Maude logo, "/ Settings", "Changes save as you go" and "Back to canvas".
- **Left menu:** settings search and the four pages. The current page is highlighted, and each item links to its artboard, so you can click between them in Preview.
- **Main column:** a heading, then groups of settings. Each setting has a label, one line of description and one control.

What's on each page:
- **General:** theme, panel density, language, design system for new canvases, dotted grid, snapping, reopen last project, update checks.
- **Account:** profile with name and email; connections to Maude Cloud, Claude and GitHub; sign out and delete account.
- **Notifications:** desktop banners, email digest, quiet hours, and a table of six events with In app, Desktop and Email checkboxes.
- **Privacy:** a short note on where your data lives, online presence, AI picture descriptions and chat history, crash reports, download your data, and clear chat history.

Settings take effect as you change them, so there's no Save button. The indigo highlight is used once per area: the current page in the left menu, plus "Connect GitHub" on Account. The styles are in a new `ui/Settings.css`, and `Settings.meta.json` has the brief, the section and the artboard positions.

Things to know:
- **Remaining warnings:** the design system check still warns about how the canvas loads the maude styles and about the hand-drawn icons. I kept both on purpose so it matches how `GitPanel` is built. Neither affects how it renders.
- **Placeholder content:** the profile name and email ("Anna Lindqvist", anna@lindqvist.studio) and the version number "2.8.16" are made up. Replace them if you want real ones.
- **No design review:** I didn't run the automated design review. Ask if you want one.
